request.question: How must Privacy Operations handle erasure request DSR-2026-0892 for Customer ID C-2231907 under CDH-4 as amended?

options.description: erase_all: Erase all personal data about the Customer now; no record needs to be retained or restricted.
erase_but_retain_transaction_records: Erase the Customer's personal data but retain, in restricted form, one or more Transaction Records whose retention period is still running.
erase_marketing_only: Erase only Marketing Data; everything else is kept.
reject_unverified_request: Take no action beyond asking for verification, because the request is not a Verified Request.
restrict_all_pending_legal_hold: Erase nothing; restrict all of the Customer's data because an active Legal Hold covers the Customer ID.
